intro: TEST FIXTURE. If you're on the road right now: turn on your hazard lights and get off the road if you can. If anyone is hurt, you see smoke, or you're stuck in a traffic lane, call 911.
whoToCall: TEST FIXTURE: 911 if anyone is hurt or you're stuck in a traffic lane.
TEST FIXTURE: your roadside plan, from your insurance card or app, or the number in your owner's manual.
